by: a structured-document validator that parses each document against the grammar and reports every defect by its shape
check.population: every agent and template document the validator walks, and every occurrence of the keyword in them
check.freshness: a verdict stands until the grammar data or a document that uses the keyword changes
check.refusal: the validation stage fails the gate on any defect code, so a document with a malformed keyword does not ship
check.observation: none: a keyword is static text in a document, and nothing observes it while a run executes
check.evidence: fires-and-accepts: a suite plants a retired head in a real template and validates every agent and template on disk clean
check.authority: the grammar data, which every keyword in a document conforms to
